[USER] User has been dealing with a lot of congestion lately.  
[USER] User is interested in trying methods to alleviate respiratory issues using essential oils.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Essential oils like eucalyptus and peppermint can be used to alleviate respiratory issues through inhalation, topical application, and aromatherapy.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] For inhalation, add 5-10 drops of eucalyptus or peppermint oil to a bowl of hot water and inhale the steam for 5-10 minutes or use a diffuser.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] For topical application, mix a few drops of eucalyptus or peppermint oil with a carrier oil and massage onto the chest and back.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] For aromatherapy, add a few drops of eucalyptus or peppermint oil to a hot bath or shower.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Essential oils should never be ingested and should be used with caution around children and pets. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult a healthcare professional before using essential oils.  
[USER] User is interested in other essential oils that are good for respiratory issues.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Other essential oils good for respiratory issues include tea tree oil, rosemary oil, lavender oil, and lemon oil.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tea tree oil has natural antibacterial, antiviral, and anti-inflammatory properties.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Rosemary oil has expectorant properties that can help clear mucus from the respiratory tract.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Lavender oil has anti-inflammatory properties that can help reduce inflammation in the respiratory tract.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Lemon oil has antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties that can help reduce respiratory inflammation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Always do a patch test before applying essential oils topically and consult with a healthcare professional before using essential oils for any health condition.
